about-info-1: Hi, I'm Mohammed Imaad Sharieff, a Software Developer and AI/ML enthusiast currently pursuing my M.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering at CMR University. I completed my B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering at Dayananda Sagar College of Engineering. My interests lie in software development, backend engineering, and artificial intelligence, with a focus on building practical and scalable applications.
about-info-2: I have gained industry experience through internships at Bluestock Fintech as a Software Development Engineer Intern and LearnNex as a Full-Stack Developer Intern. During these internships, I worked on machine learning-based financial analysis, RESTful APIs, responsive web applications, and database integration. I enjoy learning new technologies and strengthening my programming and problem-solving skills through hands-on development.
about-info-3: I have developed projects involving Generative AI, natural language processing, full-stack development, and Quantum Machine Learning. Some of my notable projects include an AI-powered Medical Chatbot, a WhatsApp Product Review Collector, and Q-BacilliNet, a hybrid quantum-classical model for tuberculosis detection. I also published a research paper on Quantum Convolutional Neural Networks and received the Best Innovation Project award. I am passionate about applying technology to solve real-world problems and continuously expanding my technical expertise.
